title: Relationship Pricing Note: Ashgrove Income Annuities Addition to Death Benefit Valuation Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
An owner who held an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract has an addition to the death benefit valuation interest of the owner's Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract.

## Rule

The income annuity relationship addition to the death benefit valuation interest is **0.10% (0.001)** where the owner held an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract with at least **12** installments issued in the twelve months before the valuation interest is credited, **0.05% (0.0005)** where the owner held an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract with at least one but fewer than 12 such installments, and nothing otherwise. The addition is added to each rate at which the death benefit valuation interest is worked.

## Records read

The owner's Ashgrove Income Annuities contract, in whatever status it now stands (payments may have stopped on the death), and the installments issued in its activity history dated in the twelve months before the valuation interest is credited.

## Judgement table

| Income Annuities contract held by the owner | Installments issued in those twelve months | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 12 or more | 0.10% |
| Yes | 1 to 11 | 0.05% |
| Yes | None | Nothing |
| No | — | Nothing |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* a monthly income annuity that issued its last installment two months before the credit and 10 installments in the twelve months gives 0.05%.
